lines.text: Valentine's Day at school! Red glitter, heart stickers, and pink paper everywhere!
Leo made bright cards for all his soccer buddies, laughing and sharing candy!
Then he noticed Toby, the shy new boy, quietly coloring alone by the window!
Toby's Valentine mailbox was completely empty—not even a single sticker inside!
Leo stopped. True kindness means making sure no friend gets left behind!
He grabbed his gold marker and drew a smiling rocket: To Toby, coolest builder in class!
When Toby opened the card, his face lit up brighter than a million fireworks!
A tiny act of kindness can turn someone's lonely day into pure magic!
